paper_id: An Empirical Study of the Landscape of Open Source Projects in Baidu, Alibaba, and Tencent
title: An Empirical Study of the Landscape of Open Source Projects in Baidu, Alibaba, and Tencent
motivation: 前期研究聚焦微软/谷歌, 中国BAT的开源价值尚不清晰
problem_framing: 用混合方法(项目分析+问卷)从三个维度刻画BAT开源项目特征
key_insight: 国际化程度高的项目(有英文README)获得了更多stars
evaluation_criteria: stars数量衡量流行度, 问卷统计态度与动机
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 声称考虑国际化的73%但实际仅55.2%项目有英文README
evidence_for_taste: the Kappa value between two labelers is 0.89
follow [20] remove projects with less than 6 commits
Effect sizes are at least small
We can notice that projects with Go, Rust, Python
projects with high internationalization effort show higher popularity
thinking_moves: 用card sorting把1000个项目手动分类为9类
问卷交叉分析不同人口学特征的差异
先观察现象再追问背后动机(M5揭示商业动机)
用客观指标(英文README)验证主观声称(73%考虑国际化)
cites_own_work: Han et al. 2019 - Characterization and prediction of popular projects
